_meta: HU terminologický lockfile pro tagra.app — vkládá se do KAŽDÉHO překladového promptu. Zdroj: SERP research 12.8.2026 + tdt.co.hu + rukon.hu.
rules: Formal address: use Ön / Önök forms consistently. Never te/ti.
Product names, brand names and file formats are NEVER translated (see no_translate).
Numbers, prices, EUR/Ft amounts, dates and legal references stay byte-identical.
Hungarian uses lowercase for common nouns in headings — do not Title Case Every Word.
Use vowel harmony correctly for suffixes; check definite/indefinite conjugation.
No calques from English: 'megoldás' only where truly 'solution'; avoid 'kontroll' for control (use ellenőrzés).
Decimal comma and space thousands separator per Hungarian convention (1 250 000 Ft).
Do not invent legal claims; 'elektronikus menetlevél' must never be presented as a legal replacement for paper records.
